21:t_2:30.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The intelligence we've gathered in these two months of fighting leaves little doubt that $$サイデリアル$$ is a military alliance of alien species.」

21:t_2:31.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If they invaded to obtain 《$$地球の次元力$$》...」

21:t_2:32.en:
$$テッサ$$
「They will probably just leave once they have drained all the $$次元力$$.」

21:t_2:35.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...$$サイデリアル$$ used the other Earth as a forward base to invade our Earth.」

21:t_2:36.en:
$$アルト$$
「The other Earth... the so-called $$翠の地球$$...」

21:t_2:37.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Since it is also Earth, $$サイデリアル$$ has probably laid $$レイライン$$s there, too.」

21:t_2:38.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$蒼の地球$$ and $$翠の地球$$... They intend to seize both Earths and take their $$次元力$$ for themselves.」

21:t_2:39.en:
$n
「Captain $$テスタロッサ$$... How long can Earth last?」

21:t_2:40.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I don't know... The Empire may have complete control of the $$レイライン$$s, and Earth might not collapse.」

21:t_2:41.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But without knowing why they are extracting Earth's $$次元力$$, we cannot predict what will happen.」

21:t_2:42.en:
$n
「Then we just have to beat them as soon as possible.」

21:t_2:43.en:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah... We also have to find out what happened to the people under their rule.」

21:t_2:44.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain, do we have any intelligence on the civilians being gathered from all over?」

21:t_2:46.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But once we defeat the $$新地球皇国$$, we can resolve everything.」

21:t_2:47.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So our target is the imperial capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

21:t_2:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「If the $$レイライン$$s collect $$次元力$$, they probably all lead to $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

21:t_2:49.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Then we can reach their headquarters by following the $$レイライン$$s.」

21:t_2:50.en:
$$宗介$$
「But with our current strength, that would be suicide.」

21:t_2:51.en:
$$アルト$$
「Some of our machines, like Captain $$アムロ$$'s $$νガンダム$$ and my $$ＹＦ－２９$$, were lost or badly damaged in these two months of fighting.」

21:t_2:52.en:
$$甲児$$
「Still, if everyone fighting in the other regions could get together...」

21:t_2:53.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But right now, they're struggling to hold their fronts. Gathering $c carelessly would leave huge gaps in those lines...」

21:t_2:54.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But if this situation goes on...!」

21:t_2:55.en:
$$アルト$$
「You don't have to tell me that...!」

21:t_2:58.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...You're all exhausted. You've pushed yourselves so hard this past week to rescue the people in that town.」

21:t_2:59.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Let's rest first. If you collapse, you won't be able to attack their headquarters or restore peace.」

21:t_2:60.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Miss $$スズネ$$ is right. Again, thank you all for your hard work.」

21:t_2:61.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Let's return to Japan for now. We can reconsider our next steps there.」

21:t_2:63.en:
$$アルト$$
「So we can finally go back to school.」

21:t_2:66.en:
$$宗介$$
「Provided we take our makeup classes.」

21:t_2:67.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It'll be all right. I'll submit a report on the Volunteer Club's activities, too.」

21:t_2:70.en:
$n
(Earth... our world... What's going to happen to it...?)

21:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $n. How is the $$ジェニオン$$ running?」

21:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n... Are you feeling a little weak?」

21:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. You hardly ever say anything like that to me, $n.」

21:t_10:9.en:
$n
「...Are you all right? You still can't contact 《$$ＤＥＭコーポレーション$$》, can you?」

21:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No... I thought we could contact parallel worlds once the 《$$時の牢獄$$》 was destroyed and the dimensional boundaries grew unstable...」

21:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If the higher-ups knew the $$ジェニオン$$ had taken a $$スフィア$$, I might even win the President's Award...」

21:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... $n, I'll use the prize money to treat you and Miss $$スズネ$$, our pilots, to something lavish!」

21:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But it's a good sign. ...It may be odd to say this when Earth is in danger...」

21:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since defeating 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》, you've become much more human, $n.」

21:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Though that's hardly my line to say, being a robot.」

21:t_10:19.en:
$n
「$$アルト$$ and the others told me to relax a little.」

21:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see... So that's why you're trying to stop being the quiet type.」

21:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... I didn't expect you to take to that.」

21:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you're changing your image, I'd recommend a haircut...」

21:t_10:27.en:
$n
(But if I could do even that, I...)

21:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's make a lively start toward your new goal!」

21:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all again today... Business, business!!」

21:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh...! Starting today, $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will sell the new parts I've acquired over the past two months.」

21:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's a new $$Ｄトレーダー$$ menu. Spend $$Ｚチップ$$s to obtain benefits that affect your entire force.」

21:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Simply put, it's like making an offering and receiving a blessing.」

21:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying, $n!? The $$Ｚクリスタル$$ embodies my dimensional merchant's soul and symbolizes hope for the future!」

21:t_10:38.en:
$n
「All right, all right. I'll take a good look at it later.」

21:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$Ｄトレーダー$$ will also keep celebrating those who become Aces by shooting down 80 or more enemies. Keep up the good work, everyone!」

22:t_000:1.en:
$$皇国兵$$
「Reporting! Resistance agents appear to have infiltrated this city!」

uncertain: 21:t_10:27: Haircut antecedent retained as even that; the thought deliberately trails off before its consequence.
21:t_10:35: Kept the religious offering/blessing analogy rather than reframing it as a purchase.
